title: Exact stationary control recurrence skipping
purpose: Qualify skipping only the exactly stationary finite recurrence of ControlSmoother and ExpressionOpticalCell; retain every moving recurrence, the original snap laws, and the first subsequent control move.
evidence_class: Software continuation contract against frozen pre-optimization recurrence, not a recovered hardware law or measurement.

gate.value_comparison: std::bit_cast<uint64_t> of every exposed double output/state; signed zeros count as different
gate.reference_policy: Freeze independently named baseline classes with an immutable source/fixture SHA256 manifest; production changes may not change these references.

control_cases: Every +/- zero current and target pairing, followed by finite coefficients of either sign and subsequent nonzero control movement.
Exactly equal finite targets spanning signed subnormal, small, ordinary, and large finite values; finite coefficients include zero, negative, positive, and smoothing coefficients.
Repeated moving, stationary, retarget, snap, and coefficient-change sequences; compare both return value and stored value on every step.
Nonfinite target/coefficient fallback at stationary and moving states retains the frozen recurrence output bits; no equality shortcut may replace NaN-producing original arithmetic.
expression_cases: All six rates and default, immediate, long, and equal-resistance optical profiles; compare tick, position, and resistance output bits after every step.

Pedal endpoints, signed zero, intermediate positions, out-of-range finite inputs, ignored nonfinite pedal writes, reset, prepare, long stationary intervals, and first/multiple moves after stationarity.
Nonfinite prepared coefficients/endpoints retain the frozen recurrence output bits; no finite shortcut may alter an invalid-profile fallback.
mutation_requirements: Returning the old equal ControlSmoother state without assigning target must fail signed-zero coverage.
Prematurely snapping a moving ControlSmoother must fail its continuation gate.
Removing the finite ControlSmoother shortcut guard must fail nonfinite fallback coverage.
Prematurely returning the requested expression pedal during optical movement must fail expression continuation.
Freezing the optical recurrence on a moving cell must fail the first and subsequent move checks.
Losing a signed-zero expression pedal must fail output-bit coverage.
Removing the finite expression shortcut guard must fail invalid-profile fallback coverage.
release_requirements: Existing core CTest remains unmodified and passes.
Root runs legacy default, legacy tails, v1 numerics, and exact v2 compatibility gates.
Preserve distinct pre/post source_factory_benchmark binaries for root to run at least three rounds per snapshot.
